name: Niraj Cement Structurals Limited
summary: Niraj Cement Structurals Limited executes various civil construction and infrastructure projects in India. The company also engages in construction of highways, expressways, turnkey projects roads, bridges, tunnels, etc. In addition, the company constructs water supply and drainage, irrigation, land storm water drainage, and other infrastructural works. Niraj Cement Structurals Limited was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
